01安全与地缘 · 2026年11月8日

霍尔木兹局势升级：周日三艘船起火，海峡交通量仅为战前约两成

Hormuz Escalation Deepens: Three Ships on Fire on Sunday as Traffic Falls to About 20% of Pre-War Levels

Iran said three ships caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday after hitting mines, with the Revolutionary Guards saying smoke from the blasts was "blanketing the strait", and claimed at least 12 vessels have hit mines and caught fire since the start of November; Tehran said the Strait would not reopen until the US makes concessions in talks. The UAE National Guard rescued 22 people from a burning cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman, and UKMTO reported a second ship on fire and a third vessel attacked near the Strait. Lloyd's List Intelligence data put traffic through the Strait at about 20% of pre-war levels, with most ships steering clear. Reuters separately reported that the semi-official Fars news agency said a third tanker had exploded and caught fire, that Saudi Aramco's administrative building in Riyadh was damaged by falling debris from a thwarted attack with no casualties, and that Iranian media linked the Saturday evening blasts to Iranian military activity rather than US missile strikes. Reuters said it could not independently verify the attacks. (Note: this item covers the new developments of 8 November; the 7–8 November tanker and UKMTO incidents were covered in yesterday's edition.)

伊朗方面称，周日三艘船在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火，革命卫队称爆炸浓烟“笼罩海峡上空”，并称自 11 月初以来至少已有 12 艘船触雷起火；伊朗称在美国于谈判中让步之前，海峡不会重新开放。阿联酋国民警卫队从阿曼湾一艘起火货船上救出 22 人，英国海上贸易行动办公室（UKMTO）报告了第二艘船起火和第三艘船在海峡附近遇袭。Lloyd's List Intelligence 最新数据显示，海峡交通量约为战前水平的 20%，多数船只选择避险。路透另报道：半官方的法尔斯通讯社称第三艘油轮爆炸起火；沙特能源部称沙特阿美在利雅得的一栋行政楼被一次未遂袭击的坠落碎片损坏，无人员伤亡；伊朗媒体称周六晚间的爆炸与伊朗军事活动有关，而非美军导弹袭击，官方电视台称未确认有导弹落入伊朗领土。路透称无法独立证实上述袭击。（注：本条为 11 月 8 日的新进展；11 月 7–8 日两艘油轮触雷与 UKMTO 散货船事件已见昨日版。）

02安全与地缘 / 能源 · 2026年11月8日

伊拉克称已与美国达成谅解，石油可经霍尔木兹海峡出口

Iraq Says It Has Reached Understanding with US to Allow Oil Exports Through Hormuz

Iraq has reached an understanding with the United States to allow Iraqi oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz via a channel near Oman, Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein told Al Jazeera. He said Iraq's losses from the Iran war and the disruption to oil exports had reached $60bn. Iraqi oil exports recovered in October to about 3.5 million barrels per day, up from 2.65 million in September.

伊拉克外长福阿德·侯赛因接受半岛电视台采访时称，伊拉克已与美国达成谅解，允许伊拉克石油经由靠近阿曼的一条航道通过霍尔木兹海峡出口。他称伊拉克因伊朗战争和石油出口中断造成的损失已达 600 亿美元。伊拉克石油出口在 10 月有所恢复，升至约 350 万桶/日，高于 9 月的 265 万桶/日。

03能源与油气 · 2026年11月8日

油价周一开盘走低，特朗普称新一轮对伊打击“不太可能”

Oil Falls at Monday's Open as Trump Says Fresh Iran Attacks "Unlikely"

Oil prices fell at Monday's open after US President Donald Trump said he was highly unlikely to order fresh attacks on Iran as long as talks to end the conflict progress. Brent was down 0.64% at $97.67 a barrel and WTI down 0.40% at $90.51 in Monday intraday trading, with Brent briefly falling more than $1. Trump had hinted at renewing major attacks after last week's US midterm elections, but there has been no sign of a large-scale military operation; Iran has said it would respond by striking US and Israeli targets.

美国总统特朗普表示，只要结束冲突的谈判取得进展，他“极不可能”下令对伊朗发动新的打击，油价周一开盘下跌。周一盘中布伦特跌 0.64% 至 97.67 美元/桶，WTI 跌 0.40% 至 90.51 美元/桶，布伦特盘中一度跌超 1 美元。特朗普此前曾暗示中期选举后可能恢复大规模打击，但目前未见大规模军事行动迹象；伊朗则称将打击美以目标作为回应。

04能源与油气 / 天然气 · 2026年11月8日

埃及进一步削减化肥厂天然气供应，能源紧张加剧

Egypt Deepens Gas Cuts to Fertilizer Makers as Energy Squeeze Tightens

Egypt has told fertilizer producers their natural gas supply will be cut by a further 33%, after an earlier 20% reduction. Egypt relies on domestic gas and growing LNG imports for power generation, but domestic output is not keeping pace with demand, and the Iran war has tightened the global LNG market and pushed prices higher. Egypt's LNG imports rose this year, peaking in July before easing from August; the government budgeted about $10.1bn for LNG in fiscal 2026/27, but prices have run above expectations. The state oil company has also stepped up imports of cheaper high-sulphur fuel oil, buying six cargoes for November and December delivery.

埃及化肥生产商接到通知，天然气供应将再削减 33%，此前已削减 20%。埃及依赖国产天然气和日益增加的进口 LNG 发电，但国内产量跟不上需求增长；伊朗战争收紧了全球 LNG 市场并推高价格。埃及今年 LNG 进口量上升，7 月达到年内高点后自 8 月回落；政府在 2026/27 财年为 LNG 预算约 101 亿美元，但价格已高于预期。埃及国有石油公司还加大了较便宜的高硫燃料油进口，购买了 6 船 11 月和 12 月交付的货物。

05能源与油气 / 油轮 · 2026年11月8日

印度石油公司拟自购原油船与 LPG 船，应对西亚危机暴露的航运风险

Indian Oil to Buy Crude and LPG Ships as West Asia Crisis Exposes Shipping Risks

Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), India's largest refiner, plans to buy its own crude oil and LPG carriers to tighten control over its energy supply chain, as shipping disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz and soaring freight rates bite. Its board has approved the purchase of several vessels, tenders were issued months ago, and IOC is also exploring building ships under India's "Make in India" programme. IOC currently operates three crude carriers and nine LPG carriers on time charter, at about $2–2.50 per barrel for chartered crude ships versus $8–10 on the spot market. About 55% of its crude came from Russia in the first half of the fiscal year, with the Middle East at 24%.

印度最大的炼油企业印度石油公司（IOC）计划购买自己的原油运输船和液化石油气（LPG）船，以加强对能源供应链的控制，应对霍尔木兹海峡周边航运中断和运费飙升。公司董事会已批准购买数艘船，招标已于数月前发出；公司还在探讨在印度“Make in India”计划下建造船舶。目前 IOC 以期租方式运营 3 艘原油船和 9 艘 LPG 船，期租原油船成本约 2–2.5 美元/桶，而现货市场运费高达 8–10 美元/桶。本财年上半年 IOC 约 55% 的原油来自俄罗斯，中东供应占 24%。

06能源与油气 / 海工 · 2026年11月9日

Equinor 委托 Kongsberg 为巴伦支海 Wisting FPSO 提供安全自动化系统

Equinor Taps Kongsberg for Barents Sea FPSO Systems

Kongsberg Maritime has been awarded a contract to supply the Safety and Automation System for Equinor's Wisting FPSO in the Barents Sea. In the initial phase Kongsberg will support front-end engineering and design (FEED) for the safety and automation scope, working with Equinor and other suppliers to mature a safe, efficient and sanctionable development concept. Wisting lies about 300 km north of the Norwegian mainland and is one of the largest undeveloped oil discoveries on the Norwegian Continental Shelf, expected to generate significant value and industrial activity over an operating life of around 30 years. (Note: Kongsberg announced the award on 6 November; Splash247 published its report on 9 November.)

Kongsberg Maritime 获合同，为 Equinor 位于巴伦支海的 Wisting FPSO 提供安全与自动化系统。初期阶段 Kongsberg 将支持该系统范围的前端工程设计（FEED），与 Equinor 及其他供应商合作，完善安全、高效、可获批的开发方案。Wisting 距挪威本土以北约 300 公里，是挪威大陆架上最大的未开发油田之一，预计约 30 年作业期内将产生可观价值与工业活动。（注：Kongsberg 于 11 月 6 日宣布获合同，Splash247 于 11 月 9 日刊发报道。）

07集装箱与港口 · 2026年11月9日

智利最繁忙集装箱港圣安东尼奥结束九天封锁，恢复运营

Chile's Busiest Container Port Reopens After Haulage Deal

Independent truckers at Chile's Port of San Antonio have called off their blockade of off-dock container depots after securing an 8% increase in haulage rates, clearing the way for cargo movements to resume at the country's busiest container gateway. The deal, reached after nine days of disruption, also lets independent hauliers negotiate directly with logistics operators and links future rate adjustments to transport costs and diesel prices. The stoppage, which began on 28 October, had delayed thousands of containers and forced two cherry shipments bound for China to divert to Valparaíso; exporters' association Frutas de Chile welcomed the deal while warning one depot had yet to join the settlement.

智利圣安东尼奥港的独立卡车司机在争取到运费上调 8% 后，取消了对港外集装箱堆场的封锁，货物运输得以恢复，该港是智利最繁忙的集装箱门户。协议达成前停运已持续九天，协议还允许独立运输商直接与物流运营商谈判，并将未来运费调整与运输成本和柴油价格挂钩。封锁自 10 月 28 日开始，已延误数千个集装箱，并迫使两批输华樱桃改道瓦尔帕莱索；出口商协会 Frutas de Chile 对协议表示欢迎，但提醒仍有一家堆场尚未加入和解。

08集装箱与港口 / 运价 · 2026年11月8日

亚洲内集装箱运价指数回落，中国港口拥堵缓解但区域枢纽仍紧张

Intra-Asia Container Index Dips as China Port Congestion Eases but Regional Hubs Stay Tight

Drewry's Intra-Asia Container Index (IACI) fell to $1,478 per 40ft container as easing congestion at Chinese ports pressured some lanes, though regional rates were still up 135% year on year. Average waiting time at Shanghai edged down from 36 to 35 hours and improved sharply at Qingdao, from 35 to 23 hours, but congestion worsened at Southeast Asian transhipment hubs, and the Shanghai–Singapore rate rose 9% in a week to $2,064 per 40ft box. Middle East tensions and high fuel costs kept the Shanghai–Jebel Ali rate at a high $8,199 per 40ft container.

德路里亚洲内集装箱运价指数（IACI）跌至每 40 英尺箱 1,478 美元，因中国港口拥堵缓解压低了部分航线运价，但区域运价同比仍上涨 135%。上海港平均等泊时间从 36 小时降至 35 小时，青岛从 35 小时大幅改善至 23 小时；但东南亚中转枢纽拥堵加剧，上海—新加坡航线运价一周上涨 9% 至每 40 英尺箱 2,064 美元。中东紧张局势和燃油成本高企使上海—杰贝阿里航线运价维持在每 40 英尺箱 8,199 美元的高位。

09港口与物流 / 智能港口 · 2026年11月9日

DP World 以杰贝阿里为中心推进无人驾驶物流

DP World Puts Jebel Ali at Heart of Autonomous Logistics Push

DP World has become the first strategic partner of SHIFFT, an autonomous logistics venture established in August by Dubai Future Foundation and UK-based Oxa, to develop driverless cargo-handling operations at Jebel Ali Port, with the technology potentially extending across its global terminal network. The programme aims to integrate self-driving vehicles into existing terminal operations — DP World currently runs more than 900 vehicles at Jebel Ali moving containers between terminals, quay cranes, storage yards and gates — covering autonomous driving systems, vehicle integration, fleet management, traffic control and intelligent routing. SHIFFT aims to establish its first scalable commercial deployment in Dubai before end-2027, and the programme could eventually extend to DP World's network of more than 60 ports and terminals, though no additional locations have been identified.

DP World 成为 SHIFFT 的首个战略合作伙伴，SHIFFT 是迪拜未来基金会与英国 Oxa 于 8 月成立的无人驾驶物流企业，双方将在杰贝阿里港开发无人驾驶货物装卸作业，技术未来可能推广至 DP World 全球码头网络。项目旨在把自动驾驶车辆融入现有码头作业——DP World 目前在杰贝阿里运行 900 多辆车辆，在码头、岸桥、堆场与闸口之间转运集装箱，涵盖自动驾驶系统、车辆集成、车队管理、交通控制与智能路径规划。SHIFFT 目标在 2027 年底前在迪拜实现首个可扩展的商业部署，项目最终可能扩展至 DP World 60 多个港口和码头，但尚未确定其他地点。

10港口与物流 / 智能港口 · 2026年11月9日

朴茨茅斯港将试行无人驾驶货运接驳

Driverless Cargo Movement Trial Heads for Portsmouth

British autonomous vehicle developer Aurrigo International is preparing to test its driverless electric Auto-Shuttle at Portsmouth International Port after securing up to £100,000 ($134,000) in UK government-backed funding. The trial, expected to begin in December, will run the shuttle on a 1 km route inside the port carrying passengers, baggage and freight in an environment shared with conventional vehicles and pedestrians, testing whether autonomous vehicles can operate safely for routine port movements. Aurrigo was selected for the next stage of the UK's Freight Innovation Fund, and sees potential to extend the technology to cargo-focused ports via its larger Auto-Cargo vehicle, though no deployment agreement for that system has been announced.

英国自动驾驶车辆开发商 Aurrigo International 在获得最高 10 万英镑（约 13.4 万美元）英国政府支持资金后，准备在朴茨茅斯国际港测试其无人驾驶电动 Auto-Shuttle。试验预计 12 月开始，接驳车将在港内 1 公里路线上运行，载运旅客、行李与货物，与常规车辆和行人共享港内环境，测试自动驾驶车辆能否安全承担日常港内运输。Aurrigo 已入选英国货运创新基金下一阶段，并认为该技术可通过更大的 Auto-Cargo 车辆推广至货运港口，但尚未宣布该系统的部署协议。

中外运集运拟为六艘集装箱船升级智能技术

Sinotrans Lines Up Smart Technology Upgrades for Six Boxships

China's Sinotrans Container Lines is preparing to upgrade six feeder containerships with intelligent onboard systems and fuel-monitoring equipment, launching a procurement process to complete installations by end-March 2027. The China Merchants Energy Shipping subsidiary issued a negotiated procurement notice on 6 November covering four 1,900 teu ships (Sinotrans Kaohsiung, Manila, Bangkok, Keelung) and two 1,100 teu vessels (Sinotrans Shanghai, Tianjin), including shipboard intelligent systems and mass flow meters for more accurate fuel measurement. Suppliers have until 10 November to submit quotations; no contract value, preferred suppliers or full system configuration have been disclosed.

中国中外运集装箱运输有限公司（Sinotrans Container Lines，招商局能源运输子公司）正准备为六艘支线集装箱船升级智能船载系统和燃油监测设备，11 月 6 日发布了议价采购公告，目标在 2027 年 3 月底前完成安装。采购范围包括四艘 1,900 TEU 船（中外运高雄、中外运马尼拉、中外运曼谷、中外运基隆）和两艘 1,100 TEU 船（中外运上海、中外运天津），包括船载智能系统和用于更精确燃油计量的质量流量计。供应商须在 11 月 10 日前提交报价；合同金额、首选技术供应商及完整软硬件配置尚未披露。

Hagland 获 2,500 万美元资助，将四艘散货船改为全电动运营

Hagland Secures $25m for Electric Bulker Overhaul

Norwegian shortsea operator Hagland Shipping has secured NOK 235.9m ($24.9m) from state enterprise Enova to convert four bulk carriers to fully electric operation using battery swapping, the largest part of a new NOK 420m ($44.4m) Enova package covering 12 battery-powered vessels and two charging facilities. Each of Hagland's four ships, including the 4,900 dwt Hagland Progress, will get 40 MWh battery systems plus wind-assisted wing sails, with depleted battery packs exchanged for charged ones at designated ports instead of lengthy alongside charging. Enova describes the vessels as potentially the first fully battery-powered bulkers on international routes from Norway, and the wider package is estimated to cut about 21,300 tonnes of CO2 a year.

挪威近海航运公司 Hagland Shipping 获得挪威国有企业 Enova 提供的 2.359 亿挪威克朗（约 2,490 万美元）资助，将四艘散货船改为全电动运营，项目旨在把电池换电引入国际干散货贸易。这是 Enova 新宣布的 4.2 亿挪威克朗（约 4,440 万美元）资助计划中最大的一部分，覆盖 12 艘电池动力船舶和两座充电设施。四艘船（包括 4,900 载重吨的 Hagland Progress）每艘将配备 40 MWh 电池系统和风力辅助翼帆，耗尽的电池组在指定港口换为充满的电池组，无需传统船用燃料即可航行。Enova 称这些船可能成为首批从挪威运营国际航线的全电池动力散货船；整个资助计划预计每年减排约 21,300 吨二氧化碳。

Novi Partners 收购英国水下机器人公司 Atlantas Marine

Novi Partners Takes Over UK Subsea Robotics Specialist

UK investment firm Novi Partners has acquired Yeovil-based subsea inspection specialist Atlantas Marine from founder Charlie Foll, for undisclosed terms, with plans to expand its remotely operated vehicle (ROV) fleet and invest in proprietary technology and data capabilities. Founded in 2000, Atlantas Marine provides ROV inspection services, equipment sales, rentals, training and support to offshore wind, oil and gas and marine infrastructure customers, including inspections of wind foundations, subsea cables and pipelines. Novi founders Josh Neely and Ben Saward have become joint managing directors, the company keeps its name and Yeovil headquarters, and Foll stays on until end-December 2026 to support the transition. (Note: the transaction completed on 2 October and was first reported on 5 November; Splash247 published its report on 9 November.)

英国投资公司 Novi Partners 已收购位于约维尔的水下检测专家 Atlantas Marine，交易条款未披露，计划扩充其遥控潜水器（ROV）船队并投资专有技术与数据能力。Atlantas Marine 成立于 2000 年，为海上风电、油气与海洋基础设施客户提供 ROV 检测服务、设备销售、租赁、培训与支持，包括风电基础、海底电缆与管道检测。Novi 创始人 Josh Neely 与 Ben Saward 出任联席董事总经理，公司保留名称与约维尔总部，创始人 Charlie Foll 留任至 2026 年 12 月底协助过渡。（注：交易已于 10 月 2 日完成、11 月 5 日见诸报道，Splash247 于 11 月 9 日刊发报道。）

Quartermaster 联手阿联酋 AI 公司 Presight 推进海事监视

Quartermaster Taps UAE AI Specialist for Maritime Surveillance Push

US maritime intelligence specialist Quartermaster has signed a memorandum of understanding with Abu Dhabi-listed AI company Presight (majority-owned by G42) during ADIPEC to explore AI-powered vessel tracking and maritime surveillance, initially focused on the UAE. The plan is to combine Quartermaster's SmartMast technology — which turns commercial vessels into mobile sensor nodes using optical, infrared and radio-frequency sensors with onboard AI — with Presight's AI and data analytics platforms to monitor vessel movements, unusual activity and threats to ports, shipping lanes and offshore infrastructure. The agreement is exploratory, with no financial commitment, named customer or deployment schedule disclosed, and comes weeks after Quartermaster raised $140m to expand its maritime intelligence network.

美国海事智能专家 Quartermaster 在阿布扎比国际石油展（ADIPEC）期间与阿布扎比上市 AI 公司 Presight（G42 控股）签署谅解备忘录，探索 AI 驱动的船舶跟踪与海事监视，初期聚焦阿联酋。计划将 Quartermaster 的 SmartMast 技术——把商船变为移动传感节点，利用光学、红外与射频传感器及船载 AI——与 Presight 的 AI 与数据分析平台结合，监测船舶动态、异常活动及对港口、航线与海上基础设施的威胁。该协议为探索性质，未披露资金承诺、具名客户或部署时间表；签署前数周，Quartermaster 刚融资 1.4 亿美元以扩展海事智能网络。

美国贸易代表办公室据报将中国相关船舶费用暂停期延至 2027 年 1 月 9 日

USTR Reported to Extend China-Linked Ship Fee Suspension to 9 January 2027

The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) has reportedly posted two 6 November notices extending relief through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on 9 January 2027, covering all 178 China Section 301 product exclusions and a further suspension of the maritime action (including the covered ship fees and Annex V.A duties), replacing arrangements due to expire on 9 November; during the suspension no maritime transport service fees would be accrued or paid. Note the conflicting accounts: Gateway Lines, which reported the notices, said its 8 November check of the Federal Register did not identify corresponding published notices, while legal analyses (Squire Patton Boggs, Partner-SHIP) and late-October trade press still describe the move as a proposal whose formal approval is "widely expected" but not yet finalised. The final status awaits confirmation in a formal Federal Register document.

美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）据报已发布两份 11 月 6 日的通知，将相关减免延长至美国东部时间 2027 年 1 月 9 日 23:59，包括全部 178 项中国 301 条款产品排除，以及海事行动的进一步暂停（涵盖相关船舶费用和附件 V.A 关税）；这取代了原定 11 月 9 日到期的安排，在新的暂停期内相关海事运输服务费无需计提或缴纳。但须注意口径分歧：发布该消息的 Gateway Lines 在 11 月 8 日核查时未在《联邦公报》上找到相应正式文件；另有法律界分析（Squire Patton Boggs、Partner-SHIP）及 10 月下旬的贸易媒体报道仍将其表述为提案，称正式批准“广泛预期”但尚未最终确定。最终状态尚待《联邦公报》正式文件确认。
